text.en: Soak dried chickpeas before cooking them, in salted water (10 to 20 g of salt per litre).
text.de: Getrocknete Kichererbsen vor dem Kochen einweichen, in gesalzenem Wasser (10 bis 20 g Salz je Liter).

why.en: The tough seed coat makes legumes slow to cook; soaking speeds it up. Salt in the soaking water makes the skins more elastic, so they burst less, and does not keep the peas from softening.
why.de: Die harte Samenschale macht Hülsenfrüchte langsam gar; Einweichen beschleunigt das. Salz im Einweichwasser macht die Schalen elastischer, sodass sie weniger platzen, und hindert die Erbsen nicht am Weichwerden.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 5 Cereals vs. Legumes, section 5.1 Cereal and Legume Introduction
sources.sentence: Legumes need to be soaked and often pressure-cooked due to a tough seed coat, higher protein content, and larger particle size.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 5 Cereals vs. Legumes, section 5.1 Cereal and Legume Introduction
sources.sentence: Two ways to speed the cooking of legumes are soaking and pressure cooking.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Seeds, Reducing Cooking Times by Presoaking, p. 488
sources.sentence: This reduces cooking time by 25% or more, and for a very basic reason: heat penetrates a dry seed faster than water does.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Seeds, Salt and Baking Soda Speed Cooking, p. 489
sources.sentence: Plain salt at a concentration around 1% (10 g/l, or 2 teaspoons/qt) speeds cooking greatly

sources.title: The Food Lab (J. Kenji López-Alt), W. W. Norton 2015, e-book
sources.place: chapter 2 SOUPS, STEWS, and the Science of Stock, section The Beans
sources.sentence: Salting beans can help tenderize their skins, preventing blowouts.

sources.sentence: Das Einweichen gelingt am besten in einer 2%igen Kochsalzlösung für ca. 1 Tag.
